sentences.text: It is the case of the petitioners that they are the owners in possession of land measuring 8 guntas in Sy.No.*52/7 (New) Sy.No.52 (old) situated at Halalu Village, Kasaba Hobli, Mysuru Taluk and District having inherited the same through their mother.
That respondent No.2 had issued the above preliminary notification proposing to acquire lands including the land belonging to the petitioners for the purpose of formation of Swarna Jayanthi Nagar.
That though the preliminary notification was issued as far back as 2007 no declaration or the final notification has been issued till date.
It is also contended That neither any award is passed nor the possession is *Correction vide Court order dated:11.01.2024 NC: 2023:KHC:32776 taken nor even the compensation paid.
As such, it is contended that the acquisition proceedings has lapsed.

3. Learned counsel for the petitioners relies on Order passed by a Co-ordinate Bench of this Court in W.P.No.47787/2016 and W.P.No.47459-461/2018(LA- UDA) dated 24.10.2016 and 26.06.2019 respectively, by which while allowing the said writ petition the very same preliminary notification dated 04.01.2007 has been quashed to the extent of land belonging to the petitioners therein.
Based on the same it is contended that the petitioners also be extended similar benefit of the order.
4. Heard.
Perused the records.

5. It is not in dispute that except issuing preliminary notification for the purpose as noted above,
there has been no progress in the process of acquisition.
Nothing has been brought on record by the respondent authorities regarding they having passed the award or taking possession or paying compensation.

That apart in view of the order dated 26.06.2019 passed in the NC: 2023:KHC:32776 aforesaid writ petition in W.P.No.47459-461/2018(LA- UDA) in respect of very same notification,
this Court is of the considered view that the present petition requires to be allowed.

Accordingly, following:
ORDER 1. Petition is allowed.
2.

Preliminary Notification dated 04.01.2007 is quashed to the extent of the land measuring 8 guntas in Sy.No.*52/7 (New) Sy.No.52 (old) situated at Halalu Village,
Kasaba Hobli, Mysuru Taluk, belonging to the petitioner.
Sd/-
